draftConfig._comment: From '2026 Draft Info.txt': 2026-08-15 9:00 PM, Mohegan Sun. The source said 'EST' but August 15 is inside daylight saving time, so Eastern is UTC-04:00 (EDT). Encoding -05:00 would make the countdown an hour late on draft night. startTime must always carry an explicit offset so the countdown is right in every timezone.
draftConfig.typeNote: Linear, not snake — the round 1 order repeats identically in rounds 2 and 3.
